title: Variable frequency drive left in local control
summary: After maintenance the drive ignores PLC start commands because its control source is set to local (keypad).

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: After maintenance the drive ignores PLC start commands because its control source is set to local (keypad).

troubleshooting.effect: PLC commands have no effect; the drive runs from its keypad only
symptoms: PLC sends the run command, drive stays stopped
Drive display shows LOC or keypad control
Drive ready, no drive fault active
evidence: Run command, ready, running and remote feedback in the PLC
Drive parameter or key for the control source
diagnosticMethod: Check that the PLC command reaches the drive (terminal or fieldbus)
repair: Switch the drive back to remote/terminal or fieldbus control
Verify start and stop from the PLC
troubleshooting.explanation: Drives can be controlled locally for maintenance. A forgotten local mode is not a fault for the drive, so it raises no alarm. PLC Lab simulates this case with a terminal-controlled drive (run terminal, ready, running and remote relay outputs); speed references and drive parameters are not simulated.
